title: CyberStatus v3 — standing × connections (ISF 2026 pilot, Run A)
source: copy of CyberStatus_v2/web (15.9.2026), edited; original folder and Qualtrics survey SV_a4Yz0Mg2EPoQHae untouched

design.randomization: client-side 50/50 on each factor at page load; or fixed by ?v=1..4 / the four launcher files (one Prolific study per version); config.force overrides for testing

final.low: rank 5 = Second Support; connections = none (separate channel)

design.members: Emma (woman), Tom (man), Taylor (gender-neutral), Pixel (nickname) — DRAFT names pending Roy (30.9); personas unchanged

config_keys.endpoint: POST receiver URL (empty = JSON download at the end)
config_keys.timeScale: multiplier for waits, reading minimums and answer timers (1 = real)
config_keys.rankChoiceSeconds: seconds allowed for each choice (vote, staircase picks, connections) before the system chooses and shows a red card; default 14
config_keys.traitsBefore: trait questionnaires right after consent; default ['spin','fpes','bdi','bpni']
config_keys.traitsAfter: trait questionnaires after the task, before the demographics; default ['npi16','lsas','soas'] (LSAS = fear matrix only)
config_keys.gameTimers: seconds before a screen continues by itself: read 20 (connections reveal, team's choices), result 15 (round result), outcome 25, state 60, wish 20, distress 20, emotions 40, slider 20, avatar 20, rankInfo 60, connInfo 45; since 1.10 the six pages between the introductions and round 1 (avatar, two instruction pages, participation slider, emotions, distress) are timed too; partial answers saved, missing = null + <key>Timeout flag

url_parameters.debug=1: testing: exposes window.D; enables standing=, acc=, ts=, traits=, auto=1, stop=N,M
url_parameters.v=1|2|3|4: fixed version: 1 high/accepted, 2 high/rejected (lonely winner), 3 low/accepted (beloved loser), 4 low/rejected; without it the cell is drawn at random (or from config.force)

measures: panas_pre (13 items: 8 PANAS + happy, humiliated, angry, lonely, sad)
avatar_pre {x, y, touched, drags, seconds, moveSeconds}

rounds[1-5]{sentence, sentenceAuto, sentenceSeconds, sentenceMs, vote, voteMs, voteAuto, pickN, pickNMs, pickNAuto, position, role, winner, finalOrder, resultMs, connPicks, connMs, connAuto, connReceived, connResultMs, state (r1, r5)}
avatar_post {x, y, touched, drags, seconds, moveSeconds}
screens (per-screen reaction-time log: n, title, ms, first, errors, end)
voteOrder / pickNOrder / connOrder per round (left-to-right order of the cards, randomized)
botOrder (order of the members for the introductions, the circle and the awareness check)
panasOrder (display order of the 13 emotions, drawn once per participant, same at both administrations)

expected_duration_min.estimated_total: 42-48 with the full trait battery at the end (BDI-II + SoAS added)

verification: 29.9.2026: all four cells end-to-end in headless Chrome at timeScale 0.05 (zero console errors, data files in test_runs/)
